summary.en: Crypto Monday: both coins open with the trend checklist confirmed short (v=-2, 1h/4h aligned) and an already-bearish 24h move (ETH -3.8%, BTC -0.44%), so no zone can be A+ today, the against-trend one capped by the checklist, the with-the-move one capped for not being a reversal. Friday's ETH CME gap (2,230) sits 4.33% above price, above the magnet threshold: it can pull price up during Monday, used as a target, never a trigger. ETH funding flips to shorts-crowded (shorts are paying), adding the exception point to its buy at yesterday's low sweep. Fear stays unchanged (29) and there is no fresh hack or ETF-outflow headline in the last 12 hours: background risk stays at MEDIO only for Iran's backdrop (a 3.4-hour-old headline, de-escalating tone). Both coins trade inside their own wide no-trade zone: watch the mapped edges, do not chase the middle.

setup.en: ETH stays the default focus. Its B buy at the PDL sweep (2,013.50 to 2,060, confluence 6 with a 4-hour FVG and the shorts-crowded funding exception) points, if triggered, toward the CME gap (2,230) as a far target; the trend checklist caps it at B even at a 6. Its B sell at the POC/VAH/PDH (2,235.85 to 2,246.04) scores even higher (10) for going with the move and the checklist, but it follows the 24h move so it is also capped at B; the CME gap magnet itself could be what pushes price right up to that edge for the sell.
